name: Autonomous Software
summary: Contract-driven software planning with fail-first oracles, write-disjoint tasks, evidence-backed microtasks, and durable memory.

brief_fields.label: Room privacy tier (private, standard, or shared)

phases.label: Brief
phases.exit: All required brief fields captured, verbatim operator rulings stored in memory, and plan passes conformance check.

phases.label: Design
phases.exit: Architecture, file boundaries, and interface contracts recorded in memory; tasks form a write-disjoint acyclic graph.

phases.label: Oracle
phases.exit: Tests and acceptance checks are written and confirmed failing before any product implementation begins.

phases.label: Build
phases.exit: All implementation tasks completed within declared surfaces and previously failing oracles now pass.

phases.label: Verify
phases.exit: Full local checks, adversarial negative controls, and evidence paths verified for every completed microtask.

phases.label: Release
phases.exit: Artifacts packaged, open items reconciled, lessons recorded in memory, and plan closed with a factual outcome.

task_types.label: Specification
micro_hints: Record problem scope, constraints, and non-goals in brief
Save verbatim operator rulings in the rules memory section
Define measurable acceptance criteria for each planned task

task_types.label: Design
micro_hints: Document component boundaries and interfaces in architecture
Assign write-disjoint file surfaces to concurrent tasks
Log key trade-offs and rejected options in decisions

task_types.label: Oracle
micro_hints: Write automated tests covering acceptance criteria first
Run new tests and capture failing output as baseline proof
Add negative control checks that fail on broken behavior

task_types.label: Implementation
micro_hints: Edit only files inside the task's declared surface
Make pre-written oracle tests pass without weakening checks
Attach test log and modified file paths as microtask evidence

task_types.label: Verification
micro_hints: Run full test suite and linters against integrated changes
Confirm real cross-component integration beyond unit mocks
Verify no secrets or out-of-scope edits entered the diff

task_types.label: Review
micro_hints: Audit diff against acceptance criteria and memory rulings
Verify every cited file path and test outcome on disk
Record confirmed defects as new tasks or open items

task_types.label: Release
micro_hints: Verify clean build, packaging, and final gate pass
Update open-items and lessons memory sections before closing
Close the plan with a factual outcome and evidence paths

granularity.rule: Keep each task scoped to an exclusive file surface and split it into small microtasks where each produces one verifiable outcome backed by file evidence.

memory_sections.label: Mission
memory_sections.hint: Project goal, target users, acceptance bar, and explicit non-goals

memory_sections.label: Rules
memory_sections.hint: Verbatim operator rulings and hard constraints; never paraphrase or silently drop

memory_sections.label: Decisions
memory_sections.hint: Technical choices with rationale, alternatives rejected, and revision context

memory_sections.label: Architecture
memory_sections.hint: Modules, data flows, interface contracts, and write-disjoint surface boundaries

memory_sections.label: Open Items
memory_sections.hint: Blocked work, deferred tasks with trigger conditions, and unanswered operator questions

memory_sections.label: Lessons
memory_sections.hint: Failure modes observed during execution paired with the concrete check or rule preventing recurrence
